terms.definition: Discrete-state diffusion model with forward corruption and reverse denoising Markov processes.
terms.ambiguity_notes: Includes language and image tokens; not continuous diffusion.

terms.definition: Masked diffusion with absorbing mask noise; k=0 XDLM endpoint.
terms.ambiguity_notes: Mask noise is distinct from causal-attention masking.
Uniform transition does not imply uniform model logits.

terms.definition: miXed Diffusion Language Modeling with stationary uniform-plus-mask noise kernel.
terms.ambiguity_notes: The mixture is in the noise kernel, not an ensemble.

terms.definition: Time-invariant kernel structure whose schedule weights vary with time.
terms.ambiguity_notes: Stationary refers to kernel structure, not constant marginals.

terms.definition: Token-level posterior and KL algebra using r(e) and f_t(x,e) without explicit NxN transition matrices.
terms.ambiguity_notes: Does not eliminate vocabulary-wide model logits.

terms.definition: Perplexity-based generated-sample quality metric under a fixed sampling budget.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: Time-varying mixed kernels couple noise structure to schedule and require expensive recomputation.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Fix kernel structure and move temporal dependence to scalar alpha/beta schedules.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Time-inhomogeneous kernels may be more expressive but cost more.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: MDLM and UDLM each fail to balance understanding and few-step generation.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: k controls token refinement versus mask-based semantic construction.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Task-dependent k and non-uniform targets may outperform fixed k=0.1.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: Explicit NxN transitions are prohibitive for large vocabularies.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Use r(e), f_t(x,e), gather/scatter and scalar ratios instead of materializing transition matrices.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Direct matrices are more general; scalar algebra is implementation-complex and still reads vocabulary logits.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: Small s-to-t gaps make the first log-ratio numerically unstable.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Replace it by its asymptotic limit.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Exact finite-step KL may avoid approximation bias but be less stable.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: Balance training throughput with posterior numerical precision.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: bf16 reduces training memory while float64 can stabilize sampling arithmetic.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Float64 raises bandwidth and compute cost; no matched ablation exists.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: Show scalability and adapt a strong masked diffusion LLM to XDLM.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Continue pretraining the existing 8B model for 600 steps under XDLM.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: The extra training budget confounds mechanism attribution.
